candidate.name: O4b visible direct typed Tool authoring contract

canary.stop_reason: Case 1 repeated the O4 undeclared-days output failure, and the generated Workflow still used zero direct Tool executors despite the now-visible mandatory authoring rule.

case_results.summary: The draft passed validate_travel_plan, but the final Agent added a days key to day 1. The eight-Step Workflow contained only Agent executors.
The next case had begun an outer request but was interrupted before authoring a Workflow or producing an answer.

tokens.candidate_observation_caveat: The full-chain totals include partial case-48 authoring and omit one cancelled request, so they are not a complete case-1 comparison.

adoption.author_behavior: The author introduced sorting, top-k projection, field projection, and multi-call merging into collector Steps, then classified those transformations as reasons to keep every collector Agent-backed.

notes: The initial Workflow incorrectly declared Step identities as both Step and Agent, then used an undeclared agent executor; a second revision used the wrong allowed_tool arity. The third revision compiled.
Making the capability visible was necessary but not sufficient: the author added avoidable collection transformations that bypassed the direct lookup rule.
The completed Workflow used more model calls than O4 case 1 and produced no Tool-side zero-token records.
No evaluator or remaining canary cases were run after the fixed-case quality failure and zero-adoption finding.
